prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Divya didi, Tanuja didi, Sunil C., Sunil bhai.
The chat covers 24/03/26, 7:15 pm to 24/03/26, 9:15 pm. It must have exactly 26 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
24/03/26, 8:08 pm - Sunil bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
24/03/26, 7:15 pm - Tanuja didi: Haan Divya, payment receiver ka detail mila kya?
24/03/26, 7:18 pm - Divya didi: Haan Tanuja didi, ek naye account se 50,000 credit dikha raha hai.
24/03/26, 7:22 pm - Sunil C.: Konsa account code hai? Audit list me cross check karna hai.
24/03/26, 7:26 pm - Divya didi: HDFC branch ka hai, par naam mismatch ho raha hai.
24/03/26, 7:30 pm - Sunil bhai: Are wo customer request manual entry par update hua tha.
24/03/26, 7:34 pm - Tanuja didi: But manual entry bina OTP verify kiye kaise pass ho gaya?
24/03/26, 7:38 pm - Sunil C.: Exactly, system alert flag ho raha hai portal pe.
24/03/26, 7:42 pm - Divya didi: Mujhe lag raha hai QR code me discrepancy hai.
24/03/26, 7:47 pm - Sunil bhai: Scanner ka issue nahi hai, wo system lag tha.
24/03/26, 7:51 pm - Tanuja didi: Sunil bhai, 3 baar retry fail hone ke baad approve kaise hua?
24/03/26, 7:55 pm - Sunil C.: Bank log monitor kar raha hai, record sync karna zaroori hai.
24/03/26, 8:00 pm - Divya didi: Main manager ko mail drop kar rahi hoon summary ke saath.
24/03/26, 8:04 pm - Sunil C.: Pehle verification status clear toh hone do.
24/03/26, 8:08 pm - Sunil bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
24/03/26, 8:12 pm - Divya didi: Kyun Sunil bhai? System log bina audit ke modify nahi hota.
24/03/26, 8:16 pm - Tanuja didi: Wait, tum record delete karne ko kyun keh rahe ho?
24/03/26, 8:21 pm - Sunil C.: Sunil bhai, compliance team case review kar rahi hai.
24/03/26, 8:25 pm - Sunil bhai: Are galat batch ID me submit ho gaya tha, naya entry karna hai.
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Divya didi: Re-entry ke liye original record delete karna protocol me nahi hai.
24/03/26, 8:35 pm - Tanuja didi: Fraud reporting flag auto-trigger ho chuka hai.
24/03/26, 8:41 pm - Sunil C.: Sunil bhai, reference ID batao original transaction ki.
24/03/26, 8:47 pm - Sunil bhai: Re-entry file desk 4 par save ki hai.
24/03/26, 8:52 pm - Divya didi: Maine screenshot IT admin ko forward kar diya hai.
24/03/26, 8:58 pm - Tanuja didi: Haan, training module me fraud simulation complete karte hain.
24/03/26, 9:05 pm - Sunil C.: Module test report submit ho gayi hai final marks ke saath.
24/03/26, 9:15 pm - Tanuja didi: Ok, sab log kal 10 baje audit room me milte hain.
